newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Rain, electrocution in Karachi kill 11 people.
newsitem.headline: Rain, electrocution in Karachi kill 11 people.

text.p: Nine people were electrocuted on Monday as monsoon rain lashed the industrial port city of Karachi, doctors and police said.
A power line over a mud house snapped and fell, killing three children, a young girl and five people, police said.
Two others were killed in separate incidents, doctors said.
At least 20 people were injured in road accidents, a doctor said.
